subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your flight with us. This email is to confirm your reservation for the upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight is scheduled for departure on August 15th at 10:00 AM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to the departure time. We look forward to welcoming you on board for a pleasant journey. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. Safe travels! Best regards, The Flight Booking Team
